_comment: Version-specific binary facts for the Host. Loaded at runtime by MagnoliaHost (Mods/MagnoliaHost/data/binary.json). Every function is armed only if the running EXE SHA-256 is listed below and the bytes at rva match prefix (fail-closed). Only functions without a reflection entry belong here. Verify offline with tools/verify_binary.py.
